Withering Venom
Instant cast
Consumes a stack of Lethal Toxin from an enemy to deal 1+1.4 Points Per Level+NatP*.027 Nature damage and afflict them with Withering Venom for 20 sec.

This effect deals 2 Nature damage every 2 sec. Each time it ticks, it gains an additional stack, stacking 15 times.
